acceptanceCriteria: The collector and comparator require at least 100 valid warm samples for release-grade percentile comparison and reject 99.

The paired report covers inspect, status, Outcome, verification planning, verification reuse, small and large repositories, multi-history Work Items, single and multi-file changes, and invalid evidence with explicit unavailable reasons.

Each external sample binds applicable read/hash/parse/Git/subprocess/execution/reuse counters and non-overlapping phase boundaries, or records why a metric is unavailable; diagnostics on/off overhead is measured separately.
Development-cycle cost separately reports Contract-to-reviewable, verification-to-finish, and post-merge cleanup with raw samples, p50/p95, agent operations, and preflight rejects.
Local focused tests and repository quality gates pass; no release is published by this Work Item.
goal: Measure and compare the same scenarios on one machine and toolchain with release-grade warm samples, bind diagnostics and counters to each operation, and report explicit unknowns without claiming unsupported improvement.
intent: Produce current-version paired Runtime and development-cycle performance evidence for the four-direction convergence acceptance.
